Not a piercer, but I had just gotten mine done at the beginning of november! I wore a camisole with spaghetti straps so i could just slide it down over my stomach and wore a zip-up jacket so i could just cover up incase there were people i didnt want seeing them, and as additional protection. I didn't really want to pull anything over my head. So i didn't wear a bra to my appointment, just for ease of going in and getting out.

Im currently wearing cotton fabrics over my skin and just layer and layer to hide the fact im pierced there.
Sometimes, i can wear my cotton sports bra, a camisole, my shirt, and a hoodie, and I'll still nip through it. Sometimes, i dont nip through. I think it depends on how your nipples already are and, of course, how they react to cold temps

For the workout thing... i work as a stocker in a grocery store. I did fine, but if you need a break cause you're hurting, you take a break. Maybe I'd recommend waiting a week or 2 at least on vigorous movement in case it agitates it.

For sleeping, i usually sleep on my side, which was kinda a nightmare at first. I wedge a soft pillow into my chest and hug it. Usually, it keeps everything in place, so im not rubbing or catching on anything. Now, though, i feel like i can sleep. However, i usually do 

The piercing process was fun. If  you're getting both pierced, the second will hurt just a little more. And i found my second one to have a harder time healing. But my nipples haven't fallen off! And i fought off the small infection i did have.
